html:
The Kingdom of Bosnia was a medieval kingdom in the western Balkans from 1377 to 1463. It is on the map for 1400.

Bosnia had been a banate, ruled by a ban under loose Hungarian overlordship. Ban Stephen II added Hum in 1326, and his nephew Tvrtko I had himself crowned king in 1377, claiming the heritage of the Serbian kings of Raška as well. At his death in 1391 Bosnia was the strongest state in the region and held part of the Dalmatian coast.

Bosnia had its own Bosnian Church, seen as heretical by Rome, alongside Catholics and Orthodox. Silver and lead mines made its lords rich. After Tvrtko, great nobles fought each other and called in Hungary or the Turks. In 1463 the Ottomans conquered it and executed its last king. Today's Bosnia and Herzegovina is its heir.
sum: The Kingdom of Bosnia was a medieval kingdom in the western Balkans from 1377 to 1463. It is on the map for 1400.
